summary.text: Thomas Fix Jr. is the Republican candidate for New York State Senate District 37 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Shelley Mayer.
He is a businessman who lives in Eastchester and previously ran unsuccessfully for State Assembly District 88 in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Fix was born in Bronxville, New York, graduated from Iona University and has worked as a businessman, according to Ballotpedia.
Fix ran as the Republican and Conservative Party candidate for State Assembly District 88 in 2022 and again in 2024, losing both times to incumbent Democrat Amy Paulin.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Fix described himself as a 30-year Eastchester resident, parent and small business owner.
He listed tax relief, including on gasoline sales taxes, reducing regulations and payroll taxes on small businesses, and ending cashless bail among his key messages.
